report.clinical_summary: Patient presents with fatigue, neck lymphadenopathy, and increasing night sweats over approximately one year. Blood work has been stable over the past couple of months while under monthly monitoring. No unexplained weight loss, fevers, or chills reported. CLL is suspected or being monitored, with treatment deferred until clearly indicated due to slow progression. Patient is open to medication if it helps symptoms and benefits outweigh risks, but has concerns about side effects and long-term impacts.
